comment: Copy to ai-service/config.json (git-ignored), or run scripts/setup-local-ai.sh on a Mac to write it for you. Never put API keys here: export DASHSCOPE_API_KEY / ZHIPUAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY or put them in the git-ignored ai-service/.env.local. Providers: ollama, lmstudio, dashscope, dashscope-cn, dashscope-us, zhipu, zhipu-cn, gemini, openai, openrouter, custom. See ai-service/README.md.
